question: Does retrieval find the right context well enough to be worth testing with a model (phase 2)?

criteria.why: If retrieval misses more than a fifth of the needed context, strategy B starts phase 2 handicapped.
Superseded decisions must never reach an agent unasked.
Every requested kind that has no content must be reported, not silently empty.
Assumptions must arrive labelled as assumptions.
A package as large as the corpus offers nothing over full context.

caveat: The sample corpus is tiny (18 files). Passing here is necessary, not sufficient: phase 2 needs a larger corpus before its results mean much.
